snippet.title: Precious Paths in Pokémon GO—a new Season is here!
snippet.description:
Adventure awaits in #PokemonGO! 

Trainers, what paths will you choose in the new Season, Precious Paths?

The new Season runs from December 2, 2025 to March 3, 2026!

https://pokemongo.com/seasons/precious-paths
